messages:
IncBot: :rotating_light: P1 - GPU pool 'inference-gpu' us-west-2: capacity exhaustion detected. queue=820 (+460 in 8m), 429/503 rising. Paging oncall.

Alex (oncall): ack, I'm on. Starting incident call and pinging Jordan + Rina + Vik. Runbook link: <https://redwood/runbooks/gpu-capacity>

Jordan (sre): grabbing metrics. Any recent provisioning or placement changes? @DeployBot show last 30m deploys for provisioner/autoscaler.

DeployBot: autoscaler-service v3.2.1 deployed at 2026-03-14T18:05:02Z by vik-eng. No config diffs flagged.

Rina (ml): telemetry indicates multiple concurrent long-seq prefill jobs from two partners plus internal integration tests that started around the same time. KV cache eviction rate spiked.

Vik (infra): cloud control plane returning InsufficientInstanceCapacity errors for preferred GPU family (a100) in multiple AZs. Snippet from provisioner logs:
```
2026-03-14T18:08:45Z ERROR provisioner: allocation failed: InsufficientInstanceCapacity for instance-type a100 in us-west-2c
2026-03-14T18:08:46Z ERROR provisioner: allocation failed: InsufficientInstanceCapacity for instance-type a100 in us-west-2b
```

Jordan (sre): ok that explains pods Pending. We need fast mitigations: 1) reduce pressure from non-critical workloads 2) allow alternate GPU families 3) ad-hoc capacity from Dedicated pool if possible. Alex, can you temporarily pause scheduled internal tests and mark partner jobs for throttling?

Alex (oncall): pausing CI prefill jobs now (ci-batch pipeline) and contacting partners channel to throttle. Command run: `cictl pause pipelines prefill-*`

Clara (cs): getting inbound from trial users; a small set of PLG customers report 429s. No paid customers paging us yet. I'll post status and prep outbound messages.

Vik (infra): I'm updating provisioner allowed-instance-types to include a10x and a30 as fallback and bumping emergency_max_replicas 60->100. Applying patch:
```
provisionerctl update --name inference-gpu --add-allowed-types a10x,a30 --set emergency_max_replicas=100
```

Jordan (sre): trying an emergency eviction of low-priority pods to free GPU slots: `kubectl delete pods -l priority=low -n prod --grace-period=0 --force` -> freed ~4 pods but still insufficient.

Rina (ml): suggest switching low-tier routing to smaller model variants to reduce GPU footprint while we recover. Alex, can you apply route change for tier=trial and tier=free?

Alex (oncall): applying route change: `routectl set -s tier in (free,trial) -t model=llm-7b-fallback --apply` -> applied.

IncBot: :information_source: After routing + alt-instance update queue decreased to 260 (15m), 429/503 down to ~18%.

Clara (cs): posted status: "Degraded performance for trial/free users in us-west-2; mitigation in progress." Will follow up with affected customers.

Vik (infra): after allowing a10x/a30 families the cloud offered sufficient capacity and nodes were provisioned. Pods transitioned to Running ~6m after the policy change.

Jordan (sre): manual scale attempt: `kubectl scale deploy inference-gpu --replicas=45` succeeded once nodes available.

Rina (ml): check for quality regression on fallback models for trial users. Running quick sampling: no severe regressions, but some longer prompts truncated—documenting.

Alex (oncall): handing off to Jordan for the watch rotation. I'll be off at 19:00 PT. Jordan, take it.

Jordan (sre): taking watch. I'll create an alert for "provisioner_no_fallback" and collect logs into /incidents/1770000001/artifacts.

Vik (infra): preliminary RCA: concurrent bursty batch requests + cloud-side shortage of preferred instance types. Additionally, autoscaler v3.2.1 removed a fallback-to-other-families codepath during refactor (investigating PR #4576). When InsufficientInstanceCapacity occurred autoscaler retried without expanding instance family scope, causing a delay to recovery.

Action items (owners and due dates):
- Reintroduce instance-family fallback logic or revert PR 4576 if root cause confirmed (owner: infra/vik, due: 2026-03-17)
- Add unit/integration test simulating InsufficientInstanceCapacity and assert fallback triggers (owner: eng-runtime, due: 2026-03-21)
- Implement partner rate-limits for large prefill/batch jobs and publish partner guidance (owner: ml-platform/rina, due: 2026-03-22)
- Add small reserved buffer of pre-warmed GPU instances in us-west-2 to cover burst windows (owner: infra, due: 2026-04-05)
- Improve alerts for rapid queue growth that include suggested mitigations (owner: eng-sre, due: 2026-03-16)

Clara (cs): CS outreach: contacting the 5 most affected PLG accounts and offering goodwill credits where appropriate. No SLA violations for enterprise customers detected.

Alex (oncall): summarizing immediate mitigations: paused internal CI prefill jobs, targeted routing for low-tier traffic, allowed alternate instance types, manual eviction of low-priority pods, raised emergency_max_replicas.

Jordan (sre): I'll open the postmortem doc and schedule a meeting with infra, eng-runtime, ml-platform, and cs for 2026-03-18 10:00 PT. Expect a full timeline and artifact bundle by EOD.

IncBot: :white_check_mark: Incident marked mitigated at 2026-03-14T18:50:00Z. Monitoring mode for 90 minutes. Thread archived to incidents index."
